title: Quantum navigation
twice: This route crosses the band twice: the widest crossing is shown.
guideHint: Sets the middle of the crossing as the NPS destination, to check afterwards

position.none: Open the NPS (screen reading or /showlocation): its readings tell you here which band you are in.
position.before: {gap} short of band {band}: keep going outwards.

source.network: Bands up to date from Nexus Tools.
source.cache: Offline: bands kept from the last connection.
source.builtin: Offline: bands built into the app.

point.noTarget: Pick a destination in the NPS, “Go there” on a marker, or paste coordinates.
point.unknownBody: This point's body has no survey yet: it cannot be placed.
point.pasteInvalid: Paste the /showlocation line or the r_displayInfo Zone: SolarSystem… Pos: line.
point.goToEnd: Jump to {to} and go all the way.
point.expected: You will drop about {error} from the target (the line passes {offset} away).
point.goFirst: First go to {from}, then spool the jump.
point.noRoute: No clear route leads near this point.
point.noPosition: Open the NPS: its readings tell here how far you are.
point.precision: The offset counts a hand cut accurate to {share}% of the remaining distance, at most {max}. Routes through a planet, a moon or the star are left out.

surface.intro: This point is near the ground of {body} (altitude {altitude}): no jump is cut there.
surface.jumpTo: Jump to {place}, {distance} away, then finish flying.
surface.jumpToBody: Jump to {body}: at least {distance} will be left from the orbital markers.
